content.rendered:
What a beautiful location, We have been the St. Francis Yacht Club DJ for 20 Years.

A members only club by invitation, Wonderful food and some of the best views.

Norma Carr-Ruffino Event: small informal wedding, older group
Location: St. Francis Yacht Club
Guests: 50
Date: Friday, April 18, 2014
Times: 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM
Marina District San Francisco California Bay Area
